# Get Email From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets emails from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getEmailFrom(input: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getEmailFrom(input: "Contact support@jellycuts.com")
~~~~
